files.html:
0.2.7 Change Log

  • Improved and reorganized the Mods Config UI design.
  • Significantly improved UI visibility and layout structure across all editors.
  • Added compatibility with Dochi's NPC Core (in development). The mod is still under development.
  • Expanded NPC Shops to support multiple items as payment.
  • Fixed various UI layout issues caused by different GUI scale settings.
